plans.timeStop: Exit if the first target isn't tagged within ~30 trading days (~6 weeks), or re-evaluate at the next earnings print.
plans.rationale: Downtrend; enter on a pullback to the 511.15 anchor with the stop 1.5 ATR beyond the recent swing high (dynamic buffer). Targets at 1.5R/2.5R/4R, kept only within a realistic 30-day move (±25%). NOTE: stop is 16% of price (>15%) — structure is too loose for a clean swing; watch, don't force it.
invalidations: A close beyond 583.36 breaks structure and voids the trend setup.
Regime flips to high-vol — halve size or stand aside.
